name: Vermont

response.rule_text: Custodian has three business days to search and respond if the request cannot be filled on the spot (1 V.S.A. § 318(a)(1)); missing the deadline is a deemed denial (§ 318(a)(2)).

fees.labor_rule: Staff time chargeable when time directly involved exceeds 30 minutes, if agency agrees to create a record, or for nonstandard format (§ 316(c)); Secretary of State schedule $0.33-$0.57 per minute.
fees.copy_rule: Actual cost of copies incl. mailing (§ 316(b)); schedule $0.05 single-sided, $0.09 double-sided.
fees.estimate_required: Agency shall provide an estimate on request.
fees.late_penalty: Court may award attorney fees to a substantially prevailing complainant (§ 319(d)).

residency.rule_text: Any person may inspect or copy any public record (§ 316(a)); 'person' is not limited.

appeal.rule_text: Appeal to the agency head, who decides in five business days (§ 318(c)(1)), no time limit to file; then de novo superior court action (§ 319), no time limit stated, agency bears burden.

format_rule: Records covered regardless of physical form (§ 317(b)); if kept electronically requester may choose electronic or paper (§ 316(i)).
notes: Read chars 0-100k and 135-235k. Extension up to ten working days by written certification of unusual circumstances (1 V.S.A. § 318(b)(5), RCFP typo says 12 V.S.A.). Governor covered with qualified executive privilege. RCFP chapter dates to 2019.
